mods.name: CC: Create Redstone Link
mods.description: Bridge between Create Redstone Link and CC:Tweaked computers, with optional dye-color frequencies.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- **`watchLinkSignal` / `unwatchLinkSignal` Lua API.** Subscribe an attached computer to a `redstone_link_change` event on a frequency pair (#5, PR #6 by @leohearts). Event shape: `redstone_link_change, freq1, freq2, newStrength, oldStrength, color1, color2`. `color*` is `nil` for uncolored slots. Watch-only state is ephemeral — re-subscribe on reboot. See the README for a longer example.
- **Per-computer subscription tracking.** Each computer's `watchLinkSignal` is tracked independently, so two computers watching the same frequency pair both keep receiving events when one of them calls `unwatchLinkSignal` (which would otherwise have killed events for both). Detach cleans up subscriptions automatically.
- **Pocket / turtle bridges get events when *they* move.** Create's network handler only fires `setReceivedStrength` when a transmitter changes, so a moving pocket bridge previously wouldn't get a `redstone_link_change` for walking into a stationary transmitter's range. The pocket and turtle upgrades now re-poll their listening channels every tick the holder has actually moved, fanning out events when the perceived signal flips.

Built against Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.219 / Create 6.0.10 / CC:Tweaked 1.118.0. Sable 1.x is still an optional dependency.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- **Bridge works on Sable contraptions.** A bridge block, pocket-bridge, or turtle-bridge can now read and send signals across a Sable sub-level boundary. Both the bridge itself sitting on a flying contraption and a stationary bridge in the world will correctly see each other in `getLinkSignal` after the sub-level's `logicalPose` is applied to both endpoints — the same trick Sable's own mixin on `RedstoneLinkNetworkHandler.updateNetworkOf` uses on Create's send path.

## Compatibility

[Sable](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable) is declared as an **optional** dependency. The mod runs without Sable installed (verified with Sable + Create Aeronautics removed from the load list), and the Sable-typed code is isolated in a separate class that's only resolved when Sable is present. Pinned compile-time against Sable `1.2.2` / sable-companion `1.6.0`; runtime range is `[1.2.0, 2.0)`.

Built against Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.219 / Create 6.0.10 / CC:Tweaked 1.118.0.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- **Place the bridge on any side or the bottom of a block.** A new `FACING` block state property orients the bridge to whichever face was clicked — top (the existing behaviour), sides, or ceilings. Voxel shape and model rotation follow accordingly, and rotate/mirror are wired through so Create's wrench and vanilla world tools handle the new property.

## Backward compatibility

Bridges placed in worlds created with v0.1.x or earlier load with `FACING=UP`, keeping their original floor-sitting orientation. This is achieved by registering `UP` as the property's default value — vanilla's `BlockState` codec fills any missing property from the block's default, so no separate DataFixer registration is needed and old worlds are not modified on load.

Built against Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.219 / Create 6.0.10 / CC:Tweaked 1.118.0.

releases.notes:
## Fixes

- **Respect Create's `linkRange` config when reading signals** (#2, reported by @aldveylor). `getLinkSignal` was iterating every transmitter on the network without doing a range check, so it would pick up signals that Create's own receivers correctly ignore as out-of-range. The bridge now filters by `closerThan(bridgePos, linkRange)` against the bridge's (or holder's, for the pocket/turtle upgrade) position, matching Create's own `RedstoneLinkNetworkHandler.withinRange` behavior.

Built against Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.219 / Create 6.0.10 / CC:Tweaked 1.118.0.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- **Pocket-computer & turtle upgrades.** The Redstone Link Bridge is now also a CC:Tweaked upgrade. Craft a pocket computer (or turtle) with the bridge item to get a portable bridge peripheral. Works on both normal *and* advanced tiers.
- **3D turtle upgrade model.** Thanks @samhaygood05 (#3) for the model files.
- **Equipped variants in the creative tab.** The Redstone Blocks tab now lists pre-equipped Redstone Link Pocket Computers (normal & advanced) and Redstone Link Turtles (normal & advanced) alongside the bridge block, so you don't have to craft them by hand in creative.

Built against Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.219 / Create 6.0.10 / CC:Tweaked 1.118.0.
